segments.pe3:2.1: Lobhādhiṭṭhānaṃ dosādhiṭṭhānaṃ mohādhiṭṭhānaṃ alobhādhiṭṭhānaṃ adosādhiṭṭhānaṃ amohādhiṭṭhānaṃ kāyakammādhiṭṭhānaṃ vācākammādhiṭṭhānaṃ manokammādhiṭṭhānaṃ saddhindriyādhiṭṭhānaṃ vīriyindriyādhiṭṭhānaṃ satindriyādhiṭṭhānaṃ samādhindriyādhiṭṭhānaṃ paññindriyādhiṭṭhānaṃ.
segments.pe3:4.1: Vitakkamathitassa [vitakkanimmathitassa (ka.) dha. pa.349] jantuno, tibbarāgassa subhānupassino;
segments.pe3:4.3: Bhiyyo taṇhā pavaḍḍhati, esa kho gāḷhaṃ karoti bandhanaṃ.
segments.pe3:5.4: Esa gāḷhaṃ karoti bandhananti rāgaṃ, iti yo yo dhammo mūlanikkhitto, so yevettha dhammo uggāvahitabbo [uggāpayitabbo (pī. ka.)].
segments.pe3:5.5: Na bhagavā ekaṃ dhammaṃ ārabbha aññaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
segments.pe3:5.6: Yassa vitakketi kāmavitakko tameva vitakkaṃ kāmavitakkena niddisīyati.
segments.pe3:5.8: Subhānupassino bhiyyo taṇhā pavaḍḍhatīti tameva rāgaṃ kāmataṇhāti niddisati.
segments.pe3:5.9: Esa gāḷhaṃ karoti bandhananti tameva taṇhāsaṃyojanaṃ niddisati.
segments.pe3:6.1: Tattha bhagavā ekaṃ dhammaṃ tividhaṃ niddisati, nissandato hetuto phalato.
segments.pe3:7.1: Dadaṃ piyo [passa saṃyuttanikāye] hoti bhajanti naṃ bahū, kittiñca pappoti yaso ca vaḍḍhati;
segments.pe3:7.3: Amaṅkubhūto parisaṃ vigāhati, visārado hoti naro amaccharī.
segments.pe3:8.1: Dadanti yaṃ yaṃ dānaṃ, idaṃ dānamayikaṃ puññakriyaṃ.
segments.pe3:8.4: Bhajanti naṃ bahū, kittinti yo ca kalyāṇo kittisaddo loke abbhuggacchati, yaṃ bahukassa janassa piyo bhavati manāpo ca.
segments.pe3:8.6: Yaṃ kāyassa bhedā devesu upapajjatīti idaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.pe3:10.5: Surāmerayapānañca, yo naro anuyuñjati [abhigijjhati (pī. ka.) passa a. ni.5.174].
segments.pe3:11.1: Appahāya pañca verāni, dussīlo iti vuccati;
segments.pe3:12.3: Surāmerayapānañca, yo naro anuyuñjatīti doso nidānaṃ.
segments.pe3:12.4: Yo ca surāmerayapānaṃ anuyuñjati yathāparadāravihārī [yathāpamuditavihārī (ka.)] amittā janayanti.
segments.pe3:13.1: Pañca verāni appahāyāti pañcannaṃ bhikkhāpadānaṃ samatikkamanaṃ sabbesaṃ dosajānaṃ sā paṇṇatti, teneva dosajanitena kammena dussīlo iti vuccati sopi dhammo hetunā niddisitabbo, nissandena phalena ca.
segments.pe3:14.1: Tīṇi bālassa bālalakkhaṇāni – dubbhāsitabhāsī [dubbhāsitabhāsitā (pī. ka.) passa a. ni.3.3] ca hoti, duccintitacintī ca dukkaṭakammakārī ca.
segments.pe3:14.3: Tattha yaṃ kāyena ca vācāya ca parakkamati, idamassa dukkaṭakammakārī.
segments.pe3:14.4: Tāyaṃ yathā ca musāvādaṃ bhāsati yathā pubbaniddiṭṭhaṃ, idamassa dubbhāsitā.
segments.pe3:14.5: Yañca saṅkappeti manoduccaritaṃ byāpādaṃ, idamassa duccintitacintitā.
segments.pe3:14.6: Yaṃ so imehi tīhi bālalakkhaṇehi samannāgato tīṇi tajjāni dukkhāni domanassāni anubhavati, so ca hoti sabhaggato vā parisaggato vā tajjaṃ kathaṃ kathanti.
segments.pe3:14.7: Yadā bhavati so ca pāṇātipātādidasaakusalakammapathā, so tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedetīti.
segments.pe3:14.8: Puna caparaṃ yadā passati coraṃ rājāparādhikaṃ raññā gahitaṃ jīvitā voropetaṃ, tassevaṃ bhavati sace mamampi rājā jāneyya mamampi rājā gāhāpetvā jīvitā voropeyyāti, so tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
segments.pe3:14.9: Puna caparaṃ bālo yadā bhavati āsanā samārūḷho yāva yā me gati bhavissati ito pecca paraṃ maraṇāti so tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti iti bālalakkhaṇaṃ hetu.
segments.pe3:14.11: Kāyassa bhedā nirayesu upapajjati, idaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.pe3:16.3: Athavā pi tato bhiyyo, gabbhā gabbhaṃ gamissatha.
segments.pe3:18.1: Yo yaṃ anamataggasaṃsāraṃ samāpanno jāyate ca mīyate ca, ayaṃ avijjāhetukā.
segments.pe3:18.2: Yānipi ca saṅkhārānaṃ payojanāni, tānipi avijjāpaccayāni, yaṃ adassanaṃ buddhavacanassa, ayaṃ avijjāsutteyeva niddiṭṭhaṃ.
segments.pe3:18.3: Yo ca saṅkhāre attato harati pañcakkhandhe pañca diṭṭhiyo upagacchati.
segments.pe3:18.4: “Etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā”ti idaṃ suttaṃ avijjāya nikkhittaṃ, avijjāya nikkhipitaṃ.
segments.pe3:18.5: Evaṃ satthā sutte nayena [sutanayena (pī.)] dhammena niddisati.
segments.pe3:19.1: Ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā “idaṃ dukkhan”ti nappajānanti cattāri saccāni vitthārena, yaṃ tattha appajānanā, idaṃ dukkhaṃ, ayaṃ hetu.
segments.pe3:19.2: Appajānanto vividhe saṅkhāre abhisaṅkharoti, ayaṃ nissando.
segments.pe3:19.3: Yañca diṭṭhigatāni parāmasati “idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan”ti ayaṃ nissando.
segments.pe3:19.5: Ayampi dhammo saniddiṭṭho hetuto ca phalato ca nissandato ca.
segments.pe3:20.1: Ettha pana keci dhammā sādhāraṇā bhavanti.
segments.pe3:20.3: Yathā kiṃ bhave cattārimāni, bhikkhave, agatigamanāni.
segments.pe3:20.4: Tattha yañca chandāgatiṃ gacchati yañca bhayāgatiṃ gacchati, ayaṃ lobho akusalamūlaṃ.
segments.pe3:20.7: Evaṃ imāni tīṇi akusalamūlāni āditoyeva upaparikkhitabbāni.
segments.pe3:20.8: Yattha ekaṃ niddisitabbaṃ, tattha ekaṃ niddisīyati.
segments.pe3:20.9: Tathā dve yathā tīṇi, na hi ādīhi anikkhitte hetu vā nissando vā phalaṃ vā niddisitabbaṃ.
segments.pe3:22.1: Chandā dosā bhayā mohā, yo dhammaṃ ativattati;
segments.pe3:22.3: Nihīyati [nihīyate (pī. ka.) passa a. ni.4.17] tassa yaso, kāḷapakkheva candimā.
segments.pe3:23.1: Kattha chandā ca ayaṃ lobho yathā niddiṭṭhaṃ pubbe.
segments.pe3:25.1: “Asubhānupassiṃ [asubhānupassī (pī.) passa dha. pa.8] viharantaṃ, indriyesu susaṃvutaṃ;
segments.pe3:25.5: Taṃ ve nappasahati māro, vāto selaṃva pabbatan”ti.
segments.pe3:26.1: Tattha yā asubhāya upaparikkhā, ayaṃ kāmesu ādīnavadassanena pariccāgo.
segments.pe3:26.2: Indriyesu susaṃvuto tasseva alobhassa pāripūriyaṃ mama āyatanasocitaṃ anupādāya.
segments.pe3:26.4: Iti ayaṃ alobho asubhānupassitāya vatthuto dhārayati, so alobho hetu.
segments.pe3:26.5: Indriyesu guttadvāratāya gocarato dhārayati, bhojanemattaññutāya parato dhārayati, ayaṃ nissando.
segments.pe3:26.6: Taṃ ve nappasahati māro, vāto selaṃ va pabbatanti, idaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.pe3:26.7: Iti yoyeva dhammo ādimhi nikkhitto, soyeva majjhe ceva avasāne ca.
segments.pe3:27.1: Nāhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi asamuppannassa kāmacchandassa anuppādāya uppannassa vā pahānāya, yathayidaṃ [yadidaṃ (pī. ka.) passa a. ni.1.17] asubhanimittaṃ.
segments.pe3:27.2: Tattha asubhanimittaṃ manasikarontassa anuppanno ceva kāmacchando na uppajjati, uppanno ca kāmacchando pahīyati.
segments.pe3:27.4: Yaṃ puna anuppanno kāmarāgo pariyādiyati rūparāgaṃ arūparāgaṃ, iti phalaṃ.
segments.pe3:27.5: Iti ayampi ca dhammo niddiṭṭho hetuto ca nissandato ca phalato ca.
segments.pe3:29.1: Ekampi ce pāṇamaduṭṭhacitto, mettāyati kusalo [kusalī (ka.) passa itivu.27] tena hoti;
segments.pe3:29.3: Sabbe ca pāṇe manasānukampaṃ [anukampamāno (pī.)], pahūtamariyo pakaroti puññaṃ.
segments.pe3:30.1: Ekampi ce pāṇamaduṭṭhacitto mettāyatīti ayaṃ adoso.
segments.pe3:30.2: Nigghātena assādo, kusalo tena hotīti tena kusalena dhammena saṃyutto dhammapaññattiṃ gacchati.
segments.pe3:30.3: Kusaloti yathā paññāya pañño paṇḍiccena paṇḍito.
segments.pe3:30.4: Pahūtamariyo pakaroti puññanti tassāyeva vipāko ayaṃ lokiyassa, na hi lokuttarassa.
segments.pe3:30.7: Yāva abyāpajjo bhūmiyaṃ bahupuññaṃ pasavati, idaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.pe3:30.8: Iti adoso niddiṭṭho hetuto ca nissandato ca phalato ca.
segments.pe3:31.2: Tattha yā mettācetovimutti, ayaṃ ariyadhammesu rāgavirāgā cetovimutti, lokikāya bhūmikā hetu, yaṃ sukhaṃ āyatiṃ manāpo hoti manussānaṃ, ime ekādasa dhammā nissando.
segments.pe3:33.1: Paññā hi seṭṭhā lokasmiṃ, yāyaṃ nibbedhagāminī [nibbedhabhāginī (pī. ka.) passa itivu.41];
segments.pe3:34.7: Iti amoho niddiṭṭho hetunā ca nissandena ca phalena ca.
segments.pe3:35.1: Tīṇimāni, bhikkhave [itivu.62 tikanipāte], indriyāni anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ aññindriyaṃ aññātāvindriyaṃ.
segments.pe3:35.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu anabhisametassa dukkhassa ariyasaccassa abhisamayāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati, vīriyaṃ ārabhati, cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
segments.pe3:35.6: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu “idaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccan”ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, yā ca maggo, idaṃ aññindriyaṃ.
segments.pe3:35.7: Āsavakkhayā anāsavo hoti, idaṃ vuccati aññātāvindriyaṃ.
segments.pe3:35.9: Yaṃ chandaṃ janeti vāyamati, yā pajānāti, ayaṃ nissando.
segments.pe3:35.10: Yena sabbaso āsavānaṃ khayā hetu, yaṃ khaye ñāṇamuppajjati, anuppāde ñāṇañca, ayaṃ nissando.
segments.pe3:35.12: Tattha khīṇā me jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyanti, idaṃ khaye ñāṇaṃ.
segments.pe3:35.13: Nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmīti idaṃ anuppāde ñāṇaṃ.
segments.pe3:35.14: Iti imāni indriyāni amoho niddiṭṭho hetunā ca nissandena ca phalena ca.
segments.pe3:36.8: Yañca alobho tīṇi kammāni samuṭṭhāpeti saṅkappaṃ vāyāmaṃ samādhiñca, ayaṃ alobhassa nissando.
segments.pe3:36.10: Yaṃ tayo dhamme paṭṭhapeti sammāvācaṃ sammākammantaṃ sammāājīvañca, ayaṃ nissando.
segments.pe3:36.11: Tattha yo amoho hetu, yaṃ dve dhamme upaṭṭhapeti aviparītadassanampi ca anabhilāpanaṃ, ayaṃ nissando.
segments.pe3:36.12: Imassa brahmacariyassa yaṃ phalaṃ, tā dve vimuttiyo rāgavirāgā cetovimutti avijjā virāgā ca paññāvimutti, idaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.pe3:36.13: Iti imāni tīṇi kusalamūlāni niddiṭṭhāni hetuto ca nissandato ca phalato ca.
segments.pe3:39.2: Tattha ye saṅkhatā tulaṃ, te dve dhammā assādo ca ādīnavo ca tulitā bhavanti.
segments.pe3:39.4: Ettako ādīnavo imassa, idaṃ nissaraṇanti iti nibbānaṃ pajānāti.
segments.pe3:39.5: Dvīhi kāraṇehi atulaṃ na ca sakkā tulayituṃ.
segments.pe3:39.6: Ettakaṃ etaṃ netaṃ paramatthīti tena atulaṃ.
segments.pe3:39.7: Atha pāpuṇā ratanaṃ karitvā acchariyabhāvena atulaṃ.
segments.pe3:39.8: Tattha kusalassa ca abhisambhavā jānanā passanā, ayaṃ amoho.
segments.pe3:39.9: Yaṃ tattha ñātā osiraṇā bhavasaṅkhārānaṃ, ayaṃ alobho.
segments.pe3:39.10: Yaṃ ajjhattarato samāhitoti vikkhepapaṭisaṃharaṇā, ayaṃ adoso.
segments.pe3:39.13: Yo bhavasaṅkhārānaṃ samosaraṇaṃ lobho sammāsamādhīnaṃ assādo, ayaṃ hetu.
segments.pe3:39.14: Yaṃ ajjhattarato avijjaṇḍakosaṃ sambhedo, ayaṃ nissando.
segments.pe3:39.15: Sā pavatti imāni tīṇi niddiṭṭhāni kusalamūlāni hetuto ca nissandato ca phalato ca.
segments.pe3:40.1: Ettāvatā esā pavatti ca nivatti ca akusalamūlehi pavattati, kusalamūlehi nivattatīti imehi ca tīhi sabbaṃ akusalamūlaṃ samosaraṇaṃ gacchati.
segments.pe3:40.2: So dhamme vā vacanato niddiṭṭho taṇhāti vā kodhoti vā asampajaññanti vā anusayoti vā makkhoti vā paḷāsoti vā assatīti vā issāti vā macchariyanti vā aññāṇanti vā, tehi ye ca vatthūhi niddisitabbaṃ.
segments.pe3:40.3: Yassimāni dve vacanāni dhammapadāni niddiṭṭhāni na so atthi kilesā, yo imesu navasu padesu samodhānaṃ samosaraṇaṃ gacchati.
segments.pe3:40.4: Ayaṃ kileso, na ca lobho, na ca doso, na ca moho.
segments.pe3:41.1: Yathā akusalamūlāni, evaṃ kusalāni paṭikkhepena niddisitabbāni.
segments.pe3:43.1: Kāyena kusalaṃ kare, assa kāyena saṃvuto;
segments.pe3:44.2: Pāṇātipātā veramaṇī, adinnādānā veramaṇī, kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇī, idaṃ kāyakammādhiṭṭhānaṃ.
segments.pe3:46.1: Subhāsitaṃ [su. ni.452 suttanipāte] uttamamāhu santo, dhammaṃ bhaṇe nādhammaṃ taṃ dutiyaṃ;
segments.pe3:46.3: Piyaṃ bhaṇe nāppiyaṃ taṃ tatiyaṃ, saccaṃ bhaṇe nālikaṃ taṃ catutthaṃ.
segments.pe3:49.1: Manena kusalaṃ kammaṃ, manasā saṃvuto bhave;
segments.pe3:50.1: Tīṇimāni manosucaritāni, anabhijjhā, abyāpādo, sammādiṭṭhi, idaṃ manokammādhiṭṭhānaṃ.
segments.pe3:52.1: Vācānurakkhī manasā susaṃvuto, kāyena ca nākusalaṃ kayirā [akusalaṃ na kayirā (pī. ka.) passa dha. pa.281];
segments.pe3:52.3: Ete tayo kammapathe visodhaye, ārādhaye maggamisippaveditaṃ.
segments.pe3:53.1: Tisso imā, bhikkhave, pārisuddhiyo – kāyakammapārisuddhi, vācākammapārisuddhi, manokammapārisuddhi.
segments.pe3:54.2: Pāṇātipātā veramaṇī, adinnādānā veramaṇī, kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇī.
segments.pe3:55.1: Iti sādhāraṇāni ca suttāni asādhāraṇāni ca suttāni paṭivijjhitabbāni.
segments.pe3:55.2: Paṭivijjhitvā vācāya kāyena ca suttassa attho niddisitabbo.
segments.pe3:57.1: Yassa saddhā [saṃ. ni.1.260; theragā.507 aṭṭhakanipāte ca passitabbaṃ] tathāgate, acalā suppatiṭṭhitā;
segments.pe3:58.3: Adaliddoti taṃ āhu, amoghaṃ tassa jīvitaṃ.
segments.pe3:59.1: Saddhā ve nandikā ārādhiko, no tassa saddhoti;
segments.pe3:62.1: Ārambhatha [ārabhatha (pī.) passa saṃ. ni.1.185] nikkamatha, yuñjatha buddhasāsane;
segments.pe3:65.3: Satīmato sadā [suve (saṃ. ni.1.238)] seyyo, satīmā sukhamedhati.
segments.pe3:66.1: Cattāro satipaṭṭhānā vitthārena kātabbā, idaṃ satindriyādhiṭṭhānaṃ.
segments.pe3:68.1: Ākaṅkhato te naradammasārathi, devā manussā manasā vicintitaṃ;
segments.pe3:68.3: Sabbena jaññā kasiṇāpi pāṇino, santaṃ samādhiṃ araṇaṃ nisevato.
segments.pe3:69.1: Tayome, bhikkhave, samādhī – savitakko savicāro, avitakko vicāramatto, avitakko avicāro.
segments.pe3:72.1: Tisso imā, bhikkhave, paññā – sutamayī, cintāmayī, bhāvanāmayī, idaṃ paññindriyādhiṭṭhānaṃ suttaṃ, imāni indriyādhiṭṭhānāni asādhāraṇāni suttāni.
segments.pe3:74.1: Avītarāgo [a. ni.6.54] kāmesu, yassa pañcindriyā mudū;
segments.pe3:74.3: Saddhā sati ca vīriyaṃ, samatho ca vipassanā;
segments.pe3:75.5: Yaṃ yassa sambandhaṃ kusalassa vā akusalassa vā tena tena adhiṭṭhānena taṃ suttaṃ niddisitabbaṃ, natthañño dhammo niddisitabbo.
segments.pe3:75.6: Tattha sādhāraṇaṃ kusalaṃ nāpi kusalaṃ akusalaṃ yathā sādhāraṇāni ca kusalamūlāni sādhāraṇāni ca akusalamūlāni uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ pajahati … pe … cattāro sammappadhānā kusalaṃ akusalañca.
segments.pe3:77.1: Vitakko hi mamatthiko [pamatthiko (pī.)], dadaṃ piyo naro iti;
segments.pe3:78.3: Chandā dosā bhayā mohā, catūhi agatīhi ca.
segments.pe3:79.3: Ekampi ce piyaṃ pāṇaṃ, mittā sace subhāsitā.
segments.pe3:80.1: Paññā hi seṭṭhā lokasmiṃ, anuññā tīṇi indriyāni;
segments.pe3:81.1: Kāyena kusalaṃ kare, tīṇi sucaritāni ca;
segments.pe3:82.1: Kāyena ca kusalaṃ kayirā, manoduccaritāni ca;
segments.pe3:82.3: Kāyānurakkhī ca sadā, tisso ca pārisuddhiyo.
segments.pe3:83.1: Yassa saddhā tathāgate, samuppāde ca desito;
segments.pe3:84.3: Ākaṅkhato ca anaññāṇaṃ, ye ca tīṇi samādhayo.
segments.pe3:85.1: Paññā hi seṭṭhā lokasmiṃ, tisso paññā pakāsitā;
segments.pe3:86.1: Iti therassa mahākaccāyanassa Jambuvanavāsino peṭakopadese Tatiyabhūmi suttādhiṭṭhānaṃ nāma.
